description: Ministry of Justice - Regulation that Nominated to hear & determine of Offences under the Atomic Energy Act
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulation made by the Minister of Justice under the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978, specifically nominating the High Court of Colombo to handle cases related to the Atomic Energy Act. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and judicial procedures, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, so government classifications (1-3) do not apply.
